viewDefinition:
CREATE VIEW [STAR].[DIM_RequiredDate] AS
SELECT
	T1.[CurrentDate],
	T1.[CurrentMonth],
	T1.[CurrentYear],
	T1.[Date],
	T1.[Day],
	T1.[ISO_Week],
	T1.[LongDate],
	T1.[Month],
	T1.[PrevMonth],
	T1.[SATZ_ID],
	T1.[ShortDate],
	T1.[VeryShortDate],
	T1.[Week],
	T1.[Weekday],
	T1.[Year]
FROM
	[DWH].[DIM_Calendar] T1
